$comment: Harness x model compatibility evidence. Rows are evaluated in order; the first row whose harness matches, whose versionRange admits the runtime version and whose familyPattern matches the canonical model id wins. versionRange is "*" (any version, including an unknown one), "<=A.B.x" or ">A.B.x". When the runtime version is unknown and a version-specific row's pattern matches, the verdict is unknown. Mirrored byte-for-byte between mcpjam-inspector/shared/harness-model-support-evidence.json (source) and mcpjam-backend convex/lib/harnessModelSupportEvidence.json.
